description: Dashboard-level structure: which template to use (DASH-Q-TYPE decision node), six page templates, and eight reusable pieces (tile, card, filter bar, date range, state matrix, table with sparklines, drill-down, tooltip). Each entry lists its regions in order, the shadcn component names to build it from (check your workspace manifest for renames), the rules it must satisfy, and the Mobbin evidence. Page structure decisions between dashboard and non-dashboard pages still belong to vois-patterns; this file starts once a screen is known to be a data screen.

nodes.name: Which dashboard template?
nodes.question: Who reads it, how often, and what do they do next?

options.label: A leader scans it in under 30 seconds to know if things are OK
An operator watches live state and reacts to thresholds
An analyst asks new questions of the data each visit
It is a weekly or monthly narrative that gets exported or emailed
Users assemble their own set of widgets
The reader opened one metric and wants its full story

nodes.name: Executive summary
nodes.when: Audience is a leader; the question is 'are we on track?'; read in seconds; low interactivity.
structure: Filter row: date range with presets and a comparison control
Hero KPI row: 3 to 6 stat tiles with deltas, one hero
Primary trend: one wide line or area chart, KPI tabs optional
Breakdowns: two to four cards (top N bars, one donut, one table with sparklines)
Footer links: See all and Export
anti_patterns: Twelve equal-weight cards
Specialist forms such as violin or pairplot
Per-chart date pickers

nodes.name: Operational monitor
nodes.when: Audience is an operator; values are live or near live; thresholds and alerts matter; short windows (an hour to a week).
structure: Filter row: range (short presets), group by, source, refresh control, freshness stamp
Status strip: current state tiles with thresholds and status icons
Small multiples: one chart per signal, shared x-axis and crosshair
Breakdown table with sparkline columns and a column menu to show or hide them
Alerts or events list linked to chart annotations
anti_patterns: Re-animating on every poll
Flat zero charts for signals that aren't collected
Red and green with no icon or label

nodes.name: Analyst explorer
nodes.when: Audience is an analyst; the question changes each visit; builds queries; compares segments and periods.
structure: Toolbar row: range, comparison, granularity, chart type (5 or fewer), anomaly or forecast toggle, data freshness
Query panel (side): metrics, filter, breakdown, compare
Primary chart with legend chips that toggle series
Breakdown table beneath with visibility checkboxes, min, average, max, change and a sparkline column
Save, share and export in the header
anti_patterns: A 22-type chart picker
A group-by that produces 16 hues
Filters that reset on reload

nodes.name: Narrative report
nodes.when: Output is read weekly or monthly, exported, emailed or printed; the 'so what' matters more than exploration.
structure: Title, period and scope, locked filters stated in text
One-sentence takeaway per section
Charts with annotations on anomalies and explained dips
Text card for definitions and methodology
Export CSV and PDF; print styles
anti_patterns: Color-only encoding that dies in a greyscale print
Charts with no caption

nodes.name: Customizable widget board
nodes.when: Users compose their own dashboard from widgets and may share it.
structure: View mode: the finished board, filters row, auto-refresh and freshness
Edit mode: Add widget, drag handles, grid drop slots, dashboard variables panel, Done editing
Widget configuration panel: type (5 or fewer valid), axes, sort, color, legend and tooltip toggles
Empty board: dashed 'Add your first chart' slot
anti_patterns: Edit controls visible in view mode
A blank card when a widget is misconfigured

nodes.name: Single metric detail
nodes.when: The reader drilled into one metric from a card or a table row.
structure: Header: metric name, definition tooltip, current value and delta
Range and grain controls beneath the header
Primary chart with target or benchmark lines and annotations
Data table of record beneath, also the table twin, with export
Optional edit surface for manual data points
anti_patterns: A chart with no way to see the numbers

nodes.name: KPI tile
structure: Label (sentence case, no trailing colon), with an info icon if derived
Value (compact: 1,284 / 12.9K / $4.2M), proportional figures
Delta chip: arrow, signed percent, named baseline, color by direction times whether up is good
Optional 12-point sparkline in the de-emphasis hue, current point in the accent
As a selector: selected tile outlined with aria-selected and the chart title follows
anti_patterns: A green up-arrow on a flat zero
Bare percent with no period
Color-only delta

nodes.name: Chart card
structure: Header: title (with a chevron if it drills in) and scope subtitle on the left; actions menu on the right (expand, view as table, export, edit)
Optional KPI value with delta above the plot
Plot, in a figure with a caption and accessibilityLayer
Legend (always for 2 or more series)
Footer: scope disclosure ('1 filter') and a See all link
anti_patterns: Hand-built cards with different action placement
A chart in a div with no accessible name

nodes.name: Filter bar
nodes.when: Any dashboard with more than one card.
structure: One left-aligned row above the cards
Date range first (button showing the resolved range), comparison control next to it, then dimension filters, then group by
Active filters as removable chips with Clear all
Right side: freshness stamp, refresh, export
anti_patterns: Filters inside cards with no marker
A calendar with no presets

nodes.name: Date range picker
nodes.when: The date range control inside the filter bar.
structure: Trigger shows the resolved range, plus the timezone
Popover: presets as rows or chips (Today, Yesterday, 7, 14, 30, 90 days, This month, Year to date, All time)
Two-month calendar with the range highlighted
Footer: custom start and end fields, Cancel, Apply
Comparison select beside it, 'vs previous period' by default
anti_patterns: Making users click two dates for 'last 30 days'

nodes.name: State matrix
structure: First load: skeleton in the final geometry
Refetch: hold the previous render at reduced opacity with an inline indicator
Not set up: explain what it will show and give the connect action
Collecting data: say what's missing, the threshold and when to check back
Filtered to zero: 'No results for these filters' and Clear filters
Real zero: draw the chart with zero
Error: message and Retry inside the card, others unaffected
Misconfigured: name what's missing and open the fix
Stale or partial: badge with timestamp, hatch the incomplete period
anti_patterns: A full-page spinner
One generic 'No data' for four different situations
Six flat zero charts in a row

nodes.name: Table with sparklines and deltas
nodes.when: A ranked list where each row also has a trend.
structure: Sortable header; numbers right-aligned with tabular-nums
Value column, delta column (arrow, sign, color), then a sparkline column at the right
Sparklines axisless and muted; a column menu can hide them
Row click or arrow opens the detail view; row actions in a menu
anti_patterns: Sparklines with their own axes and legends

nodes.name: Drill-down
structure: Visible affordance: chevron in the title, See all link, or on-card hint ('Click a bar to view details')
Click lands on a filtered table or the metric detail with the same range and filters
Breadcrumb or back link restores the dashboard state
anti_patterns: A hidden click handler
A drill-down that drops the filters

nodes.name: Chart tooltip
structure: Header: the full x label
One row per series: line-key, name, value (emphasized); at most 6 rows then '+N more'
Optional delta versus previous
Surface, elevation and text tokens; textContent for data labels
Same content on keyboard focus; Esc dismisses; hoverable and persistent
anti_patterns: Tooltip as the only place a value appears
